lines.text: Paul promised the Corinthians to one husband, Christ, and feared they would be deceived like Adam was by the serpent.
Paul says the Corinthians very easily put up with someone who proclaims a different Jesus or a different gospel.
Paul considers himself in no way inferior to the super-apostles, though he is not a polished speaker.
When Paul was in need among the Corinthians, the brothers from Galatia supplied his needs, so he was no burden to them.
Paul calls the men false apostles, and says Satan himself masquerades as an angel of light.
